purpose: Attribute numeric fixed cost without touching ranking or invoking a model
basis: Eight-reader diagnostic completed all deliveries, but service work remained 1.25-1.74 seconds; previous numeric traces had sub-millisecond inner scoring and hundreds of milliseconds outside it
experiment: In the native binary, read the same configuration through an IO.Ref for each of sixteen key computations, force every result into a retained array, measure monotonic microseconds, and check all digests are identical
interpretation: A slow configuration key would justify factoring its immutable implementation digest; a fast result rejects that hypothesis. This is not an end-to-end speed or token comparison.
